# chameleon_table (Data Source)

Look up an Iceberg table's metadata.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "chameleon_table" "events" {
  catalog   = "analytics"
  namespace = "raw"
  name      = "events"
}

output "events_metadata_location" {
  value = data.chameleon_table.events.metadata_location
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `catalog` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `namespace` (String) Dot-separated namespace path.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
